method: Reviewed actual Windows app screenshots and accessibility states through Computer Use. No screenshot pixels were programmatically decoded or saved from that tool.

cases.externalDetails: Open subtitles selected the fixture external.srt. Track 3 appeared, but the previous English caption remained. Explicitly choosing Track 3 displayed EXTERNAL FIRST CUE at the same frame and position.
cases.inputLimit: Initial Space and indexed Play actions had no observed effect. A subsequent coordinate click on Play produced advancing playback; Pause via the indexed control then worked. This does not qualify keyboard activation or exact response latency. One stale file-dialog index failed before refreshed coordinate selection succeeded.

limits: Same visible marker pattern is a desktop observation, not an exact-PTS measurement; native pixel-based marker checks qualify frame conservation separately.
No cold-initial-caption, automatic external selection, complete subtitle layout, physical audibility, Windows 10, DPI or full-beta acceptance.
No recording, nonseekable, concurrent seek, unknown-frame-rate or previous-frame stress acceptance.
